title: GET (Graduate Engineer Trainee)
description: Designation: Graduate Engineer Trainee (Shift Operator) We are looking for Graduate Engineer Trainees (Shift Operators) . Freshers are welcome to apply. This role provides an opportunity to develop hands-on technical expertise in water treatment plant operations, maintenance, documentation, and operator competency. Key Responsibilities Ensure adherence to industrial safety practices during all plant operations and maintenance activities. Operate and monitor pre-treatment, water generation, storage, and distribution systems as per prescribed SOPs. Ensure optimal and safe operation of all plant equipment. Monitor utility and feed-water parameters and ensure compliance with specified operating limits. Prepare and maintain operational records, including log sheets, chemical consumption records, preventive maintenance (PM) records, and other required documentation. Verify sensor calibration using appropriate test kits and maintain relevant records. Coordinate with the QC team for water sampling and analysis. Perform basic/non-critical maintenance activities, such as attending to minor leakages, using available tools. Record operational issues, observations, and corrective actions in accordance with QA documentation procedures. Participate in classroom and hands-on technical training conducted by CN and customers to develop and maintain competency in plant operations. Assist in conducting periodic hands-on training for operators and support competency assessment and certification. Follow assigned shift schedules and support contingency arrangements at the site. Perform assigned site administrative activities, including HR compliance, documentation, invoicing, payment follow-up, and other related responsibilities. Follow all applicable SOPs, safety procedures, quality requirements, and customer/site guidelines. Eligibility Diploma in Engineering – Mechanical / Electrical / Chemical / Instrumentation / relevant discipline. Freshers are welcome to apply. Candidates with experience in DM / RO / Purified Water Systems / Utility Operations & Maintenance will also be considered. Willingness to work in shift operations and site environments. Good learning attitude, discipline, and willingness to develop technical and operational skills. How to Apply Interested candidates can directly share their CV: Email: isha.lad@cnwater.in Call / WhatsApp: 84509 64162 Pay: ₹16,000.00 - ₹19,000.00 per month Benefits: Food provided Provident Fund Work Location: In person

title: Graduate Apprenticeship Trainee - Helpdesk
description: Overview: Bruker is enabling scientists to make breakthrough discoveries and develop new applications that improve the quality of human life. Bruker’s high-performance scientific instruments and high-value analytical and diagnostic solutions enable scientists to explore life and materials at molecular, cellular and microscopic levels. In close cooperation with our customers, Bruker is enabling innovation, improved productivity and customer success in life science molecular research, in applied and pharma applications, in microscopy and nano analysis, and in industrial applications, as well as in cell biology, preclinical imaging, clinical phenomics and proteomics research and clinical microbiology. Today, worldwide more than 11,000 employees are working on this permanent challenge at over 90 locations on all continents. Bruker continues to build upon its extensive range of products and solutions, its broad base of installed systems and a strong reputation among its customers. Being one of the world's leading analytical instrumentation companies, Bruker is strongly committed to further fully meeting its customers’ needs as well as to continue to develop state-of-the-art technologies and innovative solutions for today's analytical questions. Bruker India invites fresh graduates and aspiring professionals to be a part of our prestigious Graduate Apprenticeship Program, launched under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS). This is a gateway to begin your professional journey with one of the world’s leading scientific instrumentation companies, committed to innovation, learning, and development. This structured 12-month program offers immersive learning experiences across various business functions, giving you real-time exposure to operations, technologies, and corporate dynamics. Responsibilities: In-depth working on Salesforce Service Max for case logging and management Vonage calls handling, following escalation procedures, and documentation Using remote diagnostic tools for initial issue identification Understanding log file analysis and system performance checks Shadowing experienced engineers during remote support sessions Learning how to guide customers through basic troubleshooting steps. Assisting customers with preventive maintenance tasks Engaging in advanced troubleshooting techniques Handling customer interactions and conflict resolution Contributing to the internal knowledge base and documentation. Gain hands-on experience with demo systems and software testing. Collaborating with field service engineers and other teams. Professional Growth: Learn from experienced mentors and industry leaders while working on live projects and tools. Skill Development: Sharpen your technical and analytical skills through structured training and on-the-job learning. Cross-functional Collaboration: Gain end-to-end business insights while working closely with diverse teams. Innovation Exposure: Be part of a company that empowers scientific discovery with cutting-edge solutions. Qualifications: Recent graduates (Bachelor’s) in Engineering in Electronics & communication, Instrumentation, Bachelor’s or Masters in Physics/Electronics/Instrumentation.
company_description:
We are a developer, manufacturer and distributor of high-performance scientific instruments and analytical and diagnostic solutions that enable our customers to explore life and materials at microscopic, molecular and cellular levels. Many of our products are used to detect, measure and visualize structural characteristics of chemical, biological and industrial material samples.

In close cooperation with our customers, Bruker is enabling innovation, improved productivity and customer success in life science molecular research, in applied and pharma applications, in microscopy & Nano analysis, and in industrial applications, as well as in cell biology, preclinical imaging, clinical phenomics, proteomics research and clinical microbiology.

title: Trainee Electrical Transmission Line Engineer - T&D
description: Description We Saved a Spot for You We welcome talented and ambitious graduates from all backgrounds who will help us shape the future of engineering and our company. At Burns & McDonnell India, you’ll have the opportunity to establish a thriving career within the transmission and distribution industry. The industry is evolving rapidly, driven by data centres, renewables, and the need for resilience. The grid has never been more critical. We provide tailored, end-to-end solutions that strengthen networks and prepare them for tomorrow. From planning and design to construction and operations, we blend technical insight with strategic foresight. We help our clients tackle today’s unprecedented challenges while building a robust foundation for the future. Join us in powering the world with reliable, resilient energy infrastructure. Your Responsibilities: Performing Transmission line planning, modelling, analysis and design in PLS-CADD and PLS-POLE. Structural analysis and design of line poles (Steel, LD, Wood) and loading framing trees, plan & profile drawings, authority permit drawings, wire sag and tension analysis, developing design criteria for transmission line design and create bill of materials, engineering estimate, and quality control reviews. Monitor and provide regular updates to manager about progress and activities to ensure projects remain on schedule and within budget. Provide technical and engineering expertise along the guide to identify, analyze and resolve problems. Plan, organize, estimate, schedule and effectively monitor all work activities. Support project team to develop significant engineering solutions Participate in regular meeting and corresponding with Clients. Ability and willingness to travel as needed within the continental U.S. to support assignments on projects and overall office needs. Willing to advance in career by taking increased engineering design responsibilities by closely working with discipline lead engineer Provide team level accountability for the implementation and tracking of design quality control processes and procedures utilizing all applicable QC forms and checklists. A committed team player able to work on own initiative Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, client service orientation Self-starter with excellent communication skills, both verbal and written to communicate effectively with internal team members and external clients. Additional Responsibilities: Open to candidates from Tier-2 cities. Willingness to learn transmission line engineering/design tools and processes. Flexibility to support DEF program work and other project requirements as needed. Ability to work with teams supporting the FLA office and accommodate project-related schedules. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical/Civil engineering, with 1-2 years of experience. Skills Required: Good English proficiency and strong communication skills. Strong technical foundation, analytical and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in MS Office, engineering analysis tools, and Google Earth. Quick learner with the ability to adapt to new tools and processes. Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and work with different clients globally. Flexibility to take on varied roles and responsibilities. Why Join Us? At Burns & McDonnell India, you’ll be empowered to build not just projects, but your career. Our expansive service offerings mean stability, job security and incredible potential for growth. We take on the world’s toughest challenges and use our skills, experience, and courage to solve them. A Caring Place Where Careers Grow Our entrepreneurial spirit sits at the foundation of who we are as an organization and constantly drives us forward toward innovation, strategic growth, and service excellence. We believe in putting forth our ﬁnest effort, including on behalf of our employee-owners. Our beneﬁts package includes comprehensive beneﬁts that demonstrate our commitment to the well-being of the individuals who contribute to our clients’ success every day. Work From Home (as per policy) The ability to work from home is available as per company policy, providing flexibility and work-life balance where applicable. Hybrid models may apply depending on role and department. Flextime and Day Flextime Program Flextime allows employees to choose their own start and end times within a set range. Employees have an option to choose staggered working hours — with an option to work for six hours at the office and two hours remotely — depending on their schedule. Bus Service We provide a dedicated company bus service for a comfortable, timely, and cost-effective commute for all employees. Multiple pickup points Saves on travel costs Provides on-time arrival Stress-free daily travel On-Site Fitness Facility Each on-site ﬁtness facility provides employees with convenient access to exercise equipment and classes that support physical well-being and a healthy lifestyle. Employee Engagement Activity From vibrant cultural celebrations like events that honor diversity and inclusion, we foster a workplace where everyone feels part of a thriving, collaborative culture. The events not only reflect our values but also build lasting memories, boost morale, and strengthen workplace bonds. And many more... company_description:
At Burns & McDonnell, our engineers, construction professionals, architects, planners, technologists and scientists do more than plan, design and construct. With a mission unchanged since 1898 — make our clients successful — our more than 13,500 professionals partner with you on the toughest challenges, constantly working to make the world an amazing place. 

Each professional brings an ownership mentality to projects at our 100% employee-owned firm, which has safety performance among the top 5% of AEC firms. As dedicated owners, we work through challenges until they’re resolved, meeting or exceeding our clients’ goals.

We apply this commitment to our communities, too. We live and work in the same cities you call home, so we share a passion to keep them strong and healthy. From fundraising events and community cleanups to educational outreach and mentorship — especially when it comes to sharing our passion for STEM — our professionals work to make our communities thrive.

description: Key Responsibilities 1. Machine Shop Operations Lead and manage overall machine shop activities including CNC, VMC, Grinding, EDM, and Turning operations. Ensure maximum machine utilization, productivity, and on-time delivery. Implement Lean Manufacturing, 5S, and continuous improvement initiatives. 2. Production Planning & Scheduling Coordinate with PPC, Procurement, and Supply Chain teams for smooth production flow. Plan and allocate machines, manpower, and tooling to meet production targets. Monitor daily production schedules and resolve bottlenecks. 3. Process Improvement & Technology Drive process optimization, cycle time reduction, and productivity improvements. Support new product development, prototype machining, and process validation. Implement automation and Industry 4.0 practices where applicable. 4. Conduct regular shop-floor reviews, training sessions, and performance evaluations. Foster a culture of safety, discipline, and continuous improvement. 7. Cost & Budget Control Manage machine shop operating budgets and CAPEX planning. Identify cost-saving opportunities in tooling, maintenance, and machine utilization. Improve operational efficiency while maintaining quality and delivery commitments. Requirements: Education: Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or Industrial Engineering Experience: Experience in a production machine shop environment. Must have led medium to large-scale precision machining facilities (preferably for aerospace, Defense, nuclear, semiconductor, or energy sectors). Technical Expertise: 1. Strong experience in CNC, VMC, Lathe, 4/5 Axis Rotary Tables, EDM, Surface Grinding and Cylindrical Grinding. 2. Hands-on expertise in GD&T, AS9100, ISO 9001 standards, 6-Sigma process improvements. 3. Exposure to nuclear components, aerospace materials (Titanium, Inconel, Stainless Steel), and exotic material machining techniques.
